correctness.rationale: In the quotient, nonadjacent monomials x_i x_j form a degree-two basis. Annihilator of an interior generator has degree-one dimension three; any non-coordinate line has at most dimension two, forcing permutation of interior coordinate lines and hence identity or reversal. Endpoint columns have three allowed support indices each; char2 makes all squares zero, adding c_1,c_n freedoms. Every such invertible matrix respects the presentation, giving 2q^4(q−1)^n. Independently enumerated all 4x4 binary invertible matrices preserving adjacent zero products: exactly 32. The statement concerns graded, not full automorphisms.
residual_risks: Not all full texts of characteristic-positive graph monomial automorphism literature were accessible in this bounded run; abstracts do not justify global NOT_COVERING. n=4 endpoint supports overlap as intended.
